caption: Quick toddler dinner that takes minutes… and my toddler happily eats it every single time 💛 Here’s what I do: ✨ Grab wild-caught canned sardines from @Sprouts Farmers Market (look for ones packed in water or olive oil with no added salt). ✨ Mash the sardines with the soft bones—they’re completely edible and a great source of calcium! ✨ Mix with warm rice and ¼ of an avocado. ✨ Mash everything together until combined, then roll into little balls or fun shapes for easy toddler bites. Serve it on our favorite @OmieLife plate, and dinner is done!  Save this for a busy weeknight and follow for more toddler recipes 💕 #ToddlerMeals #ToddlerDinner #EasyToddlerMeals #easyrecipe #toddlerlunch
